name: 911 Batch Repeater
description: Finds repeat parts for a 911 QTDR batch. Reads DYPN numbers from each nest's 911 Batch Excel, matches them against the Master Parts Library (.NC files) and Master Inspection Library (PDFs), and copies matches into a REPEATS folder at the batch level.
author: Anthony Sieben

fields.label: 911 QTDR Root
fields.description: Root containing '04 - Notes - Protocols - Tutorials \ TECH SERVICES \ REPEATER'. Leave blank to auto-detect '911 QTDR' under your OneDrive Pilot Program folder.
